nodes.label: Backend Permission Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Authorization is never frontend-only; every API route enforces require_roles to prevent privilege escalation

nodes.label: Async-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: All database operations use async SQLAlchemy with asyncpg to achieve high concurrency and non-blocking I/O

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Trail Design
nodes.rationale: All mutations create append-only audit records to comply with GCP regulatory requirements and prevent retroactive modification

nodes.label: Pseudonymous Participant IDs
nodes.rationale: Participants are identified by system-generated pseudonymous IDs to isolate PII from clinical trial datasets

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Security
nodes.rationale: Disallowing UPDATE and DELETE on audit logs guarantees non-repudiation and regulatory compliance

nodes.label: MFA-Ready Architecture
nodes.rationale: mfa_enabled field in User model provides schema foundation for future TOTP without breaking MVP simplicity

nodes.label: Participant De-identification Privacy
nodes.rationale: Separating PII from clinical data tables and using pseudonymous IDs ensures participant privacy compliant with clinical research standards

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys
nodes.rationale: All entities use UUIDs for global uniqueness and secure identifier distribution across distributed services and imports

nodes.label: Database Schema Constraints
nodes.rationale: UUID v4 keys, foreign key RESTRICT constraints, and immutable locked randomizations enforce data integrity and prevent cascade corruption

nodes.label: Soft Deletes Pattern
nodes.rationale: Critical entities use is_deleted flag instead of hard deletes to maintain historical integrity and regulatory audit continuity
